description: With a versatile piece like the Ameriwood Home Jensen console table, you can add a modern style to nearly any room, including your entryway, living room or bedroom. The rustic gray with brown undertones finish gives you a fresh and contemporary area to place pictures and other keepsakes. The sturdy hollow core and MDF create a sleek accent piece for any décor. The console table also features 2 shelves that are ideal for holding books and magazines. The lowest shelf includes a vertical partition that makes it even easier to arrange your belongings. The table top and Middle shelf each hold up to 100 lbs. The lower shelf can hold up to 50 lbs. On each side of the partition. Ameriwood Home Jensen console table ships flat to your door and requires assembly upon delivery. Two adults are recommended for assembly. Once assembled, this console table measures to be 28.7”H x 41.5”W x 15.5”D.
